(Matthew 26.31-35; Luke 22.31-34; John 13.36-38)
27 Jesus said to his disciples, “All of you will reject me, as the Scriptures say,
‘I will strike down
the shepherd,
and the sheep
will be scattered.’
28 But after I am raised to life, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.”
29Peter spoke up, “Even if all the others reject you, I never will!”
30Jesus replied, “This very night before a rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
31But Peter was so sure of himself that he said, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you!”
All the others said the same thing.
Jesus Prays
(Matthew 26.36-46; Luke 22.39-46)
32Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he told them, “Sit here while I pray.”
33Jesus took along Peter, James, and John. He was sad and troubled and 34told them, “I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.”
35-36Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt down on the ground and prayed, “Father, if it is possible, don't let this happen to me! Father, you can do anything. Don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
37When Jesus came back and found the disciples sleeping, he said to Simon Peter, “Are you asleep? Can't you stay awake for just one hour? 38Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.”
39Jesus went back and prayed the same prayer. 40But when he returned to the disciples, he found them sleeping again. They simply could not keep their eyes open, and they did not know what to say.
41When Jesus returned to the disciples the third time, he said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough of this! The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners. 42Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.”
Jesus Is Arrested
(Matthew 26.47-56; Luke 22.47-53; John 18.3-12)
43Jesus was still speaking, when Judas the betrayer came up. He was one of the twelve disciples, and a mob of men armed with swords and clubs were with him. They had been sent by the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses. 44Judas had told them ahead of time, “Arrest the man I greet with a kiss. Tie him up tight and lead him away.”
45Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Teacher!” Then Judas kissed him, 46and the men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
47Someone standing there pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
48Jesus said to the mob, “Why do you come with swords and clubs to arrest me like a criminal? 49 Day after day I was with you and taught in the temple, and you didn't arrest me. But what the Scriptures say must come true.”
50All of Jesus' disciples ran off and left him. 51One of them was a young man who was wearing only a linen cloth. And when the men grabbed him, 52he left the cloth behind and ran away naked.
Jesus Is Questioned by the Council
(Matthew 26.57-68; Luke 22.54,55,63-71; John 18.13,14,19-24)
53Jesus was led off to the high priest. Then the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses all met together. 54Peter had followed at a distance, and when he reached the courtyard of the high priest's house, he sat down with the guards to warm himself beside a fire.
55The chief priests and the whole council tried to find someone to accuse Jesus of a crime, so they could put him to death. But they could not find anyone to accuse him. 56Many people did tell lies against Jesus, but they did not agree on what they said. 57Finally, some men stood up and lied about him. They said, 58 “We heard him say he would tear down this temple that we built. He also claimed that in three days he would build another one without any help.” 59But even then they did not agree on what they said.
60The high priest stood up in the council and asked Jesus, “Why don't you say something in your own defense? Don't you hear the charges they are making against you?” 61But Jesus kept quiet and did not say a word. The high priest asked him another question, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the glorious God?”
62 “Yes, I am!” Jesus answered.
“Soon you will see
the Son of Man
sitting at the right side
of God All-Powerful,
and coming with the clouds
of heaven.”
63At once the high priest ripped his robe apart and shouted, “Why do we need more witnesses? 64 You heard him claim to be God! What is your decision?” They all agreed he should be put to death.
65Some of the people started spitting on Jesus. They blindfolded him, hit him with their fists, and said, “Tell us who hit you!” Then the guards took charge of Jesus and beat him.
Peter Says He Doesn't Know Jesus
(Matthew 26.69-75; Luke 22.56-62; John 18.15-18,25-27)
66While Peter was still in the courtyard, a servant girl of the high priest came up 67and saw Peter warming himself by the fire. She stared at him and said, “You were with Jesus from Nazareth!”
68Peter replied, “That isn't true! I don't know what you're talking about. I don't have any idea what you mean.” He went out to the gate, and a rooster crowed.
69The servant girl saw Peter again and said to the people standing there, “This man is one of them!”
70“No, I'm not!” Peter replied.
A little while later some of the people said to Peter, “You certainly are one of them. You're a Galilean!”
71This time Peter began to curse and swear, “I don't even know the man you're talking about!”
72At once the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered that Jesus had told him, “Before a rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you don't know me.” So Peter started crying.
translation_text:
Ba zigeri la Yezu kua
(Matu 26.1-5; Luki 22.1-2; Yɔn 11.45-53)
1 La wa gee la dabeha ayi' la azɔɛtole la boroboro zaŋa de'eŋo la paaɛ. Malema kiinduma la gɔnmi'ineba la, ɛɛra ba wan iŋɛ se'em nyɛ Yezu tuure la ba ta'am nyɔkɛ en ku, 2Ba yele taaba yeti, “Tu kan nyɔkɛ en azɔɛtole daarɛ la, tu han iŋɛ bala nɛrekuuŋɔ la wan gbirege la tɔ.”
Yezu bi'ihego Bɛtani timpaberɛ
(Matu 26.6-13; Yɔn 12.1-8)
3Yezu en ta bɔna Bɛtani Simɔn se'em iŋa n wa tabelɛ sagum la yire la, ti Yezu lagum zi'a la nɛreba yire la puan, dia saŋa ti pɔka tara dugela la kaam en tari nyuunsuŋɔ ti bu da'a kpe'em, ti ba yi'ira bu alabasita kaam wa'am na ka'ɛ yeele a zuo. 4Ti nɛreba basɛba boi bini ti ba suure nyiie, ti ba yɛta taaba yeti, “Ŋwani ti pɔka wa sagum kaam wa bahɛ bala? 5Kaam wa wan ta'am dikɛ ni koohe ti ligeri la paaɛ wuu ŋmarehi sitã yɔɔrɛ, dikɛ ni bo' naheduma.” Ti ba nyaa zɛregɛ pɔka la. 6Gee Yezu yele ba yeti, “Bahɛ ya en bããlam ŋwani ti ya daana en? A tum la sɛla n ani suŋa bo' mam. 7 Se'ere en sɔi la, naheduma la wan kelum bɔna la ya saŋa woo, ti se'em ma'a ti ya bɔta ya ta'am iŋɛ sum bo' ba. Gee mam kan bɔna la ya saŋa woo. 8Pɔka wa tum la sɛla ti ka wan ta'am tum, a te'ele bi'ihɛ la mam iŋa wa gura ka pi'a. 9N yeti ya la yelemɛŋerɛ wa, zi'a woo timpaberɛ wa zuo, ti ba ta muula faarɛ yelehum wan tiiha tɔgera sɛla ti ka iŋɛ wa yele.”
Yudasi sakɛ ti a koohe Yezu
(Matu 26.14-16; Luki 22.3-6)
10Ti Yuuduma Isikariyɔte se'em n lagum pa'ahɛ Yezu zahereba pia la bayi' la, kiŋɛ malema kiinduma zi'an ti a koohe Yezu bo' ba. 11Ban wum Yudasi puti'irɛ la, ba puurɛ pee mɛ, ti ba biŋe nuurɛ ti ba bo' en ligeri. Bala ti Yudasi nyaa malum ɛɛra sose'ere ti a wan doohe koohe Yezu.
Yezu di azɔɛtole la a zahereba
(Matu 26.17-25; Luki 22.7-14, 21-23; Yɔn 13.21-30)
12Boroboro zaŋa dia de'eŋo pɔhega daarɛ la, azɔɛtole pebila la kaabegɔ saŋa la, ti Yezu zahereba la yele en yeti, “Bɛha ti fum bɔta ti tu kiŋɛ ta maahum bo' fum ti fum di azɔɛtole la?” 13Bala ti a tum a zahereba bayi', yele ba yeti, “Kiŋɛ ya timpaberɛ la puan, ya wan ta nyɛ buraa n ziiri yoore la ko'om, dole ya en, 14Ti en ta kɛ̃' yise'ere puan la, ya kɛ̃' bini la ya soke yidaana la yeti, ‘Pa'ala la yeti, bɔ'ɔ kuni ti mam la n zahereba la wan kɛ̃' bini di azɔɛtole dia la?’ 15A wan pa'alɛ ya bɔkãtɛ en boi a yire la zuo, pun maahum zɛ'a maahum ya sɛla woo bo' tu.” 16Bala ti a zahereba la yehe kiŋɛ timpaberɛ la puan ta nyɛ sɛla woo wuu en pun yele ba se'em la. Ti ba nyaa maahum azɔɛtole dia la sɛla woo bilam.
17Yinɛ ta ma'ɛ, ti Yezu la a zahereba pia la bayi' la wa'am yire la puan. 18Ti ban zi'ire ba'ahɛ dita la, ti Yezu yele ba yeti, “N yeti ya la yelemɛŋerɛ wa, ti ya puan ayima en yeti a koohe mam. Se'em en naaɛ la mam dita wa.” 19Ti ba suure sagum ti ba sɔkera en ayima ayima yeti, “La dela mam yo'?” [“Ti ayima me yeti, mam ka ti'ihɛ la dela mam.”] 20Ti a yele ba yeti, “La dela ya pia la bayi' la puan ayima, se'em n fike boroboro kɔ'ɔm tuna laa puan la mam wa. 21La de asira ti Asaala Dayua la wan ki doohe la ban gulehɛ a yele se'em beŋe la, gee yele bu fum se'em daana n koohe Asaala Dayua tihɛ la zuo. La ani ni suŋa ti ba pun da dɔgɛ ni en.”
Yezu zi'ire azɔɛtole dia puan
(Matu 26.26-30; Luki 22.14-20; 1 Korintiduma 11.23-25)
22Ban boi bini dita la, ti Yezu dikɛ boroboro purɛ sum bahɛ de zuo gee fike de buyi' bo' a zahereba la, gee yele ba yeti, “To'e ya la ya obe, mam iŋa n ŋwana.” 23Ti Yezu le dikɛ wula la daam, n bo' Yinɛ fara ba'ahɛ la, a dikɛ bo' ba mɛ ti ba za'a nyu de puan. 24A yele ba yeti, “Mam nɔpu'ulegɔ ziim n ŋwana, wan ka'ɛ faaɛ nɛreba zo'e zo'e bahɛ. 25N yeti ya la yelemɛŋerɛ wa, mam ka le makɛ nyu tiihi wala daam wa la ya gura daanse'ere daarɛ ti n wan ta nyu bu paalum paalum Yinɛ sɔ'ɔlum la puan.”
Yezu pun yele Pita ki'ihegɔ yele
(Matu 26.31-35; Luki 22.31-34; Yɔn 13.36-38)
26Ban yuum pu'uhegɔ yuuma ba'ahɛ la, ti ba yehe kiŋɛ ta zom Olive Zoore zuo. 27 Ti Yezu yele ba yeti, “Ya za'a wan ta bahɛ mam, se'ere sɔi la, ba gulehɛ yeti,
‘N wan ŋmɛ dunkiina la,
gee ti piihi la yirum.’
28 Gee n han ta vo'e n kum la puan la, n wan diŋɛ ya nɛŋa kiŋɛ Galilii.” 29Ti Pita yele Yezu yeti, “Ba za'a han pun ta bahɛ hɔ, gee mam kan bahɛ hɔ.” 30Ti Yezu yele en yeti, “Yelemɛŋerɛ ti n yɛta fum, ti zina daarɛ wa, yu'ukuna wa, nɔdɔɔ ta kaahɛ buyi' la, ti fum pun ki'ihɛ mam la butã.” 31Ti Pita lebehe Yezu la ninmu'urɛ yeti, “La han pun dɛna la n ki la hɔ. Mam kan bahɛ fum.” Ti a zahereba la me woo lagum yele bala.
Yezu pu'uhɛ Gɛtesemane
(Matu 26.36-46; Luki 22.39-46)
32Ba kiŋɛ la zi'an kayima ti ba yi'ira Gɛtesemane, ti ban paaɛ la, Yezu yele ba yeti, “Zi' ya ka'lam gee ti n kiŋɛ ta pu'uhɛ.” 33A looe la Pita la Yemesi la Yɔn, ti ba kiŋɛ fii wa, ti a iŋa kɔ'ɔhɛ ti a suure sagum. 34Ti a yele ba yeti, “N suure n ba' sagum zo'e ana wuu n ki mɛ la. Ze' ya ka'lam gura mam, biheri ya da gihere ya.” 35En nyaa kiŋɛ nɛŋa fii la ti a lu timpaberɛ pu'uhɛ yeti, la han wan ta'am iŋɛ, bahɛ ti namehegɔ kuna tole gee bahɛ mam. 36A yeti, “Aba, di vuurɛ dela n Sɔ, fum zi'an sɛla ka boi n kan ta'am tum, to'e namehegɔ wanɛ wa n zi'an gee dagi mam sumboolum gee fum sumboolum tum.” 37Gee lebe na paaɛ, nyɛ ti a zahereba la gihi mɛ, ti a yele Pita yeti, “Simɔn, yamam gihere mɛ? Yamam kan ta'am piga paaɛ gogo mune ma'a? 38Niiɛ ya, la ya pu'uhɛ ti ya da lu pã'ahebe'o saŋa wa puan. Sia la kɔ'ɔm bɔta mɛ gee inganɛ la en tari tɔregɔ.” 39Gee le kiŋɛ lebe ta pu'uhɛ, le yele en pun yele ni se'em mɛa. 40Gee le lebe na paaɛ ti ba gihere mɛ, se'ere en sɔi la, ba nini n vilegeri. Ti ba me ka mina ban wan yele en se'em. 41Ti a kiŋɛ gee le lebe butã puan na yele ba yeti, “Ya kelum giha mɛ gee sũna? La seke ya! Saŋa la paaɛ na. Ba koohe Asaala Dayua la bo' la be'em duma. 42Ihege ya, bahɛ ya ti tu kinɛ ya, bihɛ ya, se'em n koohe mam la n ŋwana.”
Yezu nyɔkerɛ
(Matu 26.47-56; Luki 22.47-53; Yɔn 18.3-12)
43Ban kelum bɔna bini tɔgera la, bilam bilam ti Yudasi en lagum pa'ahɛ pia la bayi' la en bala en paaɛ na la nɛrekuuŋɔ, ti ba zãla sɔ'ɔhi la dɔya ze'ele malema kiinduma, gɔnmi'ineba, la yizuto kiinduma la ze'a na. 44Ŋma'ara la bo' ba la daalehum buyina yeti, “Se'em ti n ta kɔkɛ la, eŋa en bala, nyɔkɛ ya en bo' gureba la ti ba tari en kiŋɛ.” 45Bala, Yudasi n wa'am na paaɛ la, bilam bilam ti a tɔ Yezu, kiŋɛ paaɛ a zi'an yeti, “Pa'ala!” Gee kɔkɛ en. 46Ti ba nyaa paaɛ Yezu zi'an nyɔkɛ en. 47Ti nɛreba la n ze' la Yezu la, ayima nyaa fooe a su'a kɛ̃' malema kiinduma la ayima yameŋa tuberɛ bahɛ. 48Ti Yezu yele ba yeti, “Ŋwani ti ya yehe na la sɔ'ɔhi la dɔya ti ya nyɔkɛ mam wuu n dela nageyiga? 49Daarɛ woo mam boi mɛ la ya pu'uhegɔ yire la puan pa'ala, ti ya ka nyɔkɛ mam. Gee ŋwana wa wan bahɛ ti gulehegɔ la dɛna asira.” 50Ba za'a bahɛ en mɛ gee zɔ. 51Ti budibele paalega kayima n lobe a fugɔbesuŋa ma'a pi' a mɛŋa dɔla Yezu poore ti ba ta gurɛ en, 52ti a zugum pilege fugɔbesuŋa la bahɛ ba gee zɔ la beele.
Yezu paaɛ kiinduma nɛŋan
(Matu 26.57-68; Luki 22.54-55, 63-71; Yɔn 18.13-14, 19-24)
53Ti ba nyaa tari Yezu kiŋɛ Malema nɛŋadaana la zi'an, bala ma'a ti malema kiinduma, yizuto kiinduma, la gɔnmi'ineba pun lagehɛ mɛ maahum zi'an bini. 54Ti Pita me bɔna pooren pooren ha dɔla Yezu fifihe, wa'am na lagum kɛ̃' malema nɛŋa daana la zinzaka puan, lagum zi'a la tuntuneba la ɔɔha bugum. 55Ti malema nɛheduma la kiinduma la za'a nyaa biha se'em n wan ta'am parum yelese'ere bo' Yezu ti ba doohe bilam ku en. Gee ba ka nyɛ se'ere bala. 56Se'ere en sɔi la, nɛreba zo'e zo'e yehe na parum mɛ gee ba pumpɔreŋɔ la ka naaɛ. 57Basɛba yehe na parum bo' en yeti, 58 “Tumam wum n yeti ‘N wan gbi' pu'uhegɔ yire wa ti asaala mɛ wa bahɛ gee malum mɛ kuyima ti asaala ka mɛ dabeha atã puan.’ ” 59Gee bamam me n yele se'em la kelum ka naaɛ. 60Ti Malema nɛŋadaana la ihege saazuo ba nɛŋan soke Yezu yeti, “Fum ka tari se'ere n wan lerege? Beni yɛla n bala ti ba tara bɔ'ɔra fum wa?” 61Ti Yezu sina, ka yɛta se'ere. Ti malema nɛŋadaana la le soke n yeti, “Fum en de Kiresta la? Fum en de sum za'a daana Dayua la?” 62Yezu yeti, “Mam en bala, gee
‘ya wan nyɛ Asaala Dayua la
ti a zi'a paŋadaana la zuɔ nu'o
bɔna saazuo sagbama puan kina na.’ ”
63Ti Malema nɛŋadaana la ihege aahum a mɛŋa futo gee yele nɛreba la yeti, “Ŋwani ti tu kelum ɛɛra se'em ti a wa'am na yele se'ere. 64 Ya wum n tu Yinɛ se'em, Yamam puti'irɛ dela deni?” Ti nɛrekuuŋɔ la za'a tahera ti Yezu galum mɛ, nara a ki. 65Ti sɛba pɔhɛ tubeha nɔtuurum ma'ara en, ti sɛba me pi' a nini gee ŋmɛ' en, gee yele yeti, “Bukɛ ani n ŋmɛ fum wa.” Ti gureba la mɛ sooe ŋmɛ en paaɛ paaɛ.
Pita ki'ihɛ Yezu
(Matu 26.69-75; Luki 22.56-62; Yɔn 18.15-18, 25-27)
66Pita en kelum zi'a Malema nɛŋadaana la zinzakan la, ti Malema nɛŋadaana la tuntuna en de pugela wa'am zinzakan la na. 67Eŋa n nyɛ ti Pita ɔɔhi bugum la, ti a bihɛ Pita zii gee yeti, “Fum me daa lagum bɔna mɛ la Yezu en de Nazareti nɛra la.” 68Ti Pita ki'ihɛ yeti, aayi. “Mam ka mi' en, bii n bɔkɛ fum tɔgeri se'ere wa.” Gee ihege kina tɔɔra zanɔren bɔba ha, ti nɔdɔɔ kaahɛ. 69Ti Pugela wa en de tuntuna wa la, le nyɛ Pita nyaa pɔhɛ yɛta sɛba n ze' bilam la yeti, “Burakana wa dela Yezu nɛreba la ayima.” 70Ti Pita le ki'ihɛ. Ti la iŋɛ fii wa ti sɛba en ze' bini la ayima yele Pita yeti, “Yelemɛŋerɛ fum sirum dela ba puan ayima se'ere en sɔi la, fum dela Galiliiŋa.” 71Ti Pita pɔhɛ pɔta gee yeti, “Mam ka mi' buraa wa ti fum yɛta wa.” 72Sankana ma'a la ti nɔdɔɔ le kaahɛ pa'ahɛ buyi'. Ti Pita tiɛ ti Yezu pun yele en yeti, “Nɔdɔɔ ta kaahɛ pa'aha buyi' la, ti fum pun ki'ihɛ eŋa la butã.” Ti a suure sagum ti a kele.

english_text:
Pilate Questions Jesus
(Matthew 27.1,2,11-14; Luke 23.1-5; John 18.28-38)
1Early the next morning the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met together with the whole Jewish council. They tied up Jesus and led him off to Pilate.
2He asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
“Those are your words,” Jesus answered.
3The chief priests brought many charges against Jesus. 4Then Pilate questioned him again, “Don't you have anything to say? Don't you hear what crimes they say you have done?” 5But Jesus did not answer, and Pilate was amazed.
The Death Sentence
(Matthew 27.15-26; Luke 23.13-25; John 18.39—19.16)
6During Passover, Pilate always freed one prisoner chosen by the people. 7And at that time there was a prisoner named Barabbas. He and some others had been arrested for murder during a riot. 8The crowd now came and asked Pilate to set a prisoner free, just as he usually did.
9Pilate asked them, “Do you want me to free the king of the Jews?” 10Pilate knew that the chief priests had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
11But the chief priests told the crowd to ask Pilate to free Barabbas.
12Then Pilate asked the crowd, “What do you want me to do with this man you say is the king of the Jews?”
13They yelled, “Nail him to a cross!”
14Pilate asked, “But what crime has he done?”
“Nail him to a cross!” they yelled even louder.
15Pilate wanted to please the crowd, so he set Barabbas free. Then he ordered his soldiers to beat Jesus with a whip and nail him to a cross.
Soldiers Make Fun of Jesus
(Matthew 27.27-30; John 19.2,3)
16The soldiers led Jesus inside the courtyard of the fortress and called together the rest of the troops. 17They put a purple robe on him, and on his head they placed a crown they had made out of thorn branches. 18They made fun of Jesus and shouted, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” 19Then they beat him on the head with a stick. They spit on him and knelt down and pretended to worship him.
20When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the purple robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross. 21 Simon from Cyrene happened to be coming in from a farm, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross. Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus.
Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross
(Matthew 27.31-44; Luke 23.27-43; John 19.17-27)
22The soldiers took Jesus to Golgotha, which means “Place of a Skull.” 23There they gave him some wine mixed with a drug to ease the pain, but he refused to drink it.
24 They nailed Jesus to a cross and gambled to see who would get his clothes. 25It was about nine o'clock in the morning when they nailed him to the cross. 26On it was a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, “This is the King of the Jews.” 27-28 The soldiers also nailed two criminals on crosses, one to the right of Jesus and the other to his left.
29 People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and shouted, “Ha! So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days. 30Save yourself and come down from the cross!”
31The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said to each other, “He saved others, but he can't save himself. 32If he is the Messiah, the king of Israel, let him come down from the cross! Then we will see and believe.” The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus.
The Death of Jesus
(Matthew 27.45-56; Luke 23.44-49; John 19.28-30)
33About noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until around three o'clock. 34 Then about that time Jesus shouted, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you deserted me?”
35Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, “He is calling for Elijah.” 36 One of them ran and grabbed a sponge. After he had soaked it in wine, he put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus. He said, “Let's wait and see if Elijah will come and take him down!” 37Jesus shouted and then died.
38 At once the curtain in the temple tore in two from top to bottom.
39A Roman army officer was standing in front of Jesus. When the officer saw how Jesus died, he said, “This man really was the Son of God!”
40-41 Some women were looking on from a distance. They and many others had come with Jesus to Jerusalem. But even before this they had been his followers and had helped him while he was in Galilee. Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of the younger James and of Joseph were two of these women. Salome was also one of them.
Jesus Is Buried
(Matthew 27.57-61; Luke 23.50-56; John 19.38-42)
42It was now the evening before the Sabbath, and the Jewish people were getting ready for that sacred day. 43A man named Joseph from Arimathea was brave enough to ask Pilate for the body of Jesus. Joseph was a highly respected member of the Jewish council, and he was also waiting for God's kingdom to come.
44Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, and he called in the army officer to find out if Jesus had been dead very long. 45After the officer told him, Pilate let Joseph have Jesus' body.
46Joseph bought a linen cloth and took the body down from the cross. He had it wrapped in the cloth, and he put it in a tomb that had been cut into solid rock. Then he rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb.
47Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body was placed.
translation_text:
Yezu paaɛ Naba Palete nɛŋan
(Matu 27.1-2, 11-14; Luki 23.1-5; Yɔn 18.28-38)
1Beere n ta yilegera la, bilam bilam ti malema kiinduma lagum la kiinduma za'a la gɔnmi'ineba la, maahum ba puti'irɛ, nyaa lu' Yezu nu'uhi tari en ta bo' Palete. 2Ti Palete soke Yezu yeti, “Fum n de Yuuduma naba la?” Ti Yezu lerege en yeti, “La dela fum yele se'em n bala.” 3Ti Malema nɛheduma parum yɛla zo'e zo'e bo' Yezu 4Bala ti Palete soke en yeti, “Fum kan lerege? Bihɛ ban yele yɛla zo'e zo'e se'em bahɛ fum zuo.” 5Gee Yezu ka lebehe en se'ere, ti la iŋɛ Palete pakerɛ.
6Azɔɛtole de'eŋo saŋa woo, Palete ni yehe la nɛra ayima paka deo la bahɛ, ban soke en ti a yehe se'em woo. 7Bala buraa kayima yu'urɛ n wa yi'ira Barabase bɔna paka deo la a tuunfi'iha taaba, n tum tuunfi'iha ta ta' la nɛreba kua tingbiregere zaberɛ puan la. 8Bala ti nɛrekuuŋɔ la lagehɛ na pɔhɛ yɛta Palete yeti, tum fum ni tuunɛ se'em la bo' tu. 9Ti Palete soke ba yeti, “Ya boti n yehe la Yuuduma naba la bo' ya?” 10Se'ere en sɔi la, Palete mi' ti la dela nintɛrega zuo ti Malema kiinduma la nyɔkɛ Yezu wa'am na bo' en. 11Gee Malema kiinduma la nyaŋɛ pa'ahɛ nɛrekuuŋɔ la mɛ ti ba yeti, ba boti la a tugum yehe Barabase bo' ba. 12Palete le tɔgɛ la ba yeti, “Gee ya boti n iŋɛ buraa wa ti ya yi'ira Yuuduma naba wa la ŋwani?” 13Ti ba voole bahɛ na yeti, “Kpa' ya en pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo!” 14Ti Palete soke ba yeti, “Ŋwani, a iŋɛ la beni taalɛ?” Ti ba malum voole gaŋɛ bala yeti, “Kpa' ya en pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo!” 15Palete n boti a iŋɛ ti nɛrekuuŋɔ la puurɛ pee la zuo ti a yehe Barabase bo' ba, gee bahɛ ti ba ŋmɛ Yezu, gee nyaa dikɛ Yezu bo' ba ti ba tari ta kpa' en pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo.
Pɛntiireba ɛ̃regeri Yezu
(Matu 27.27-31; Yɔn 19.2-3)
16Ti Pɛntiireba la tari Yezu kɛ̃' naba zinzaka la puan (ka'lam dela timbihega zuo zi'an n bala) gee nyaa yi' taaba lagehɛ, ba tansuga la za'a. 17Ti ba dikɛ fumɔlegɔ yɛ Yezu gee pã'am gu'uhi muŋa vuge a zuo. 18Nyaa pɔhɛ ti bamam na'aha en mɛ nyaa yɛta yeti, “Naa Yuuduma Naba wa! Bɔna wuuha!” 19Gee ŋmɛ'ɛra a zuo la dɔya, tubeha nɔtuurum ma'ara a nɛŋa, kpa'ara duma wuu ba na'ahɛ en mɛ la. 20Ban ɛregɛ en ba'ahɛ la, ba yɛɛ fumɔlegɔ la mɛ, gee tee a mɛŋa futo yɛ en gee tari en kiŋɛ ti ba ta kpa' en pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo.
Yezu kpa'a Pumpuuredɔɔ zuo
(Matu 27.32-44; Luki 23.26-43; Yɔn 19.17-27)
21 Ban boi sore zuo yɛ' la, ba tu'uhɛ la buraa kayima n kinɛ ka kinɛ ti ka yu'urɛ yi'ira Simɔn, yehe Saarin timpaberɛ na, dɛna Alɛgezanda la Arufuse duma sɔ, ti ba pɛregɛ en ti a zi Yezu pumpuuredɔɔ la. 22Ba tari Yezu wa'am na paaɛ la zi'an ti ba yi'ira Gɔlegɔta (di vuurɛ dela zuowama zi'an). 23Bilam ti ba dikɛ daam ti mɛɛ bɔna bini bo' en ti a zagehɛ. 24Ti ba kpa' en pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo, gee nyaa ŋmɛ gbaŋa ti ba tɔrɛ a lɔgerɔ la.
25La wa dɛna la gogo kaareŋa awai bulika ti ba kpa' Yezu. 26Ti ba nyaa gulehɛ yelese'ere zuo ti ba kpa' en la yeti, “Yuuduma Naba.” 27Gee ba me kpa' la fãareba bayi' la en, ti ayima bɔna a zuɔ ti ayima me a gɔbega. 28[Ŋwana ti ban gulehɛ Yinɛ yeti, Ba kãalɛ en pa'ahɛ la be'em duma puan la wan wa'am yelemɛŋerɛ na]. 29 Ti sɛba n dole tɔla, lɔbera ba zuto gee tuura yeti, “Iiie! Fum se'em n wan gbirege pu'uhegɔ yire gee mɛ ku dabeha atã la n bala, 30to'e fum mɛŋa bahɛ gee ze'ele pumpuuredɔɔ wa zuo sigena!” 31Bala mɛa ti Malema kiinduma la gɔnmi'ineba la ɛregera Yezu bɔ'ɔra taaba yeti, “A faari la basɛba gee kan ta'am faaɛ a mɛŋa. 32Bahɛ ya ti se'em n de Kiresta la, dɛna Izirale naba la ze'ele pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo sige nananawa na, ti tu nyɛ gee sakɛ.” Ti sɛba ti ba kpa' ba la Yezu la me ɛregera en bala me.
Yezu kum
(Matu 27.45-56; Luki 23.44-49; Yɔn 19.28-30)
33Ti la ta paaɛ gogo muma pia la ayi', wuntɛɛŋa ti lika wa'am na pi' timpaberɛ la za'a gareti tara bala la gogo atã. 34 Gogo atã la puan ti Yezu kaahɛ supi yeti, “Eloi Eloi lama sabakitani?” De vuurɛ dela, “N Yinɛ N Yinɛ, ŋwani ti fum bahɛ mam?” 35Ti nɛresɛba n ze' bini gee wum la yeti, “Kelehe ya, a yi'ira la Elia.” 36Ti nɛra ayima zɔ ta dikɛ soosoo tum dami'ihego puan, dikɛ vile dɔɔ, nyaa zɛkɛ dikɛ tuhera a nuuren, ti a bihɛ a wan nyu, “Bahɛ ya ti bihɛ ya Elia wan wa'am na faaɛ en pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo sige na.” 37Bilam ti Yezu kaahɛ supi', gee vo'ohe a vo'ohum za'a. 38Ti Yinɛ deo tanɛ la n beŋe fa'a saraa la ahegɛ buyi' ze'ele de zuo ta paaɛ timpaberɛ. 39Ti Pɛntiireba nɛŋa daana se'em n biheri pɛntiireba kɔbega la n ze' gura Yezu la, n nyɛ ti a vo'ohum la ba'ahɛ se'em la ti a yeti, “Asira, buraa wa dela Yinɛ dayua!” 40 Ti Pɔgehi sise'ehi me zɛ'a zaaɛ zaaɛ ha gee biha na. Pɔge se'ehi n pa'ahɛ si puan dela Mɛɛri Magedalin, la Mɛɛri se'em n de Yemesi bila, la Yose ma, la Salome. 41Nɛreba wa daa ni dɔla en mɛ gee bihera en, se'em ma'a ti a bɔna Galilii, la pɔgehi kekeko n doohe en zom Yerusalɛm na.
Yezu laarɛ
(Matu 27.57-61; Luki 23.50-56; Yɔn 19.38-42)
42Yinɛ n ta ma'a la, ti daanse'ere n de maaheŋɔ daarɛ la, dabehe se'ere n gee bɔ'ɔra vo'ohego dabeherɛ la, 43ti Arimatiya buraa yu'urɛ n yi'iri Yosefe dɛna zuodaana pa'ahɛ kiinduma la puan gee me dɛna se'em n me daa guri ti a nyɛ Yinɛ sɔ'ɔlum la. Eŋa n kãbɛ suure kiŋɛ Palete zi'an ta suhɛ ti a bo' en sore ti a dikɛ Yezu iŋa la laaɛ. 44Ti Palete bu'ura nyaa Yezu pilum ki mɛ, bala ti a yi' Pɛntiireba nɛŋa daana se'em n biheri pɛntiireba kɔbega la la n ze' ni gura Yezu la soke en nyaa Yezu ki ti la yuue? 45Ti en wum Pɛntiireba nɛŋadaana n biheri se'em n biheri pɛntiireba kɔbega la zi'an ti Yezu ki mɛ la, ti a bo' Yosefe sore ti a dikɛ kum la. 46Ti Yosefe nyaa da' tansunɛ nyaa kiŋɛ ta nyakɛ Yezu iŋa la pɔbɛ tansunɛ la ti a da la puan, tari ta laaɛ yɔɔ ti n kerehe kɔ taŋa puan gee bilege kugere lige yɔɔ la nuurɛ. 47Ti Mɛɛri Magedalin la Yosefe ma Mɛɛri nyɛ ba gã'arɛ Yezu zi'an.

english_text:
Jesus Is Alive
(Matthew 28.1-8; Luke 24.1-12; John 20.1-10)
1After the Sabbath, Mary Magdalene, Salome, and Mary the mother of James bought some spices to put on Jesus' body. 2Very early on Sunday morning, just as the sun was coming up, they went to the tomb. 3On their way, they were asking one another, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance for us?” 4But when they looked, they saw that the stone had already been rolled away. And it was a huge stone!
5The women went into the tomb, and on the right side they saw a young man in a white robe sitting there. They were alarmed.
6The man said, “Don't be alarmed! You are looking for Jesus from Nazareth, who was nailed to a cross. God has raised him to life, and he isn't here. You can see the place where they put his body. 7 Now go and tell his disciples, and especially Peter, that he will go ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.”
8When the women ran from the tomb, they were confused and shaking all over. They were too afraid to tell anyone what had happened.
ONE OLD ENDING TO MARK'S GOSPEL
Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene
(Matthew 28.9,10; John 20.11-18)
9Very early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen to life, he appeared to Mary Magdalene. Earlier he had forced seven demons out of her. 10She left and told his friends, who were crying and mourning. 11Even though they heard that Jesus was alive and that Mary had seen him, they still would not believe it.
Jesus Appears to Two Disciples
(Luke 24.13-35)
12Later, Jesus appeared in another form to two disciples, as they were on their way out of the city. 13But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either.
What Jesus' Followers Must Do
(Matthew 28.16-20; Luke 24.36-49; John 20.19-23; Acts 1.6-8)
14Afterwards, Jesus appeared to his eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them because they were too stubborn to believe the ones who had seen him after he had been raised to life. 15 Then he told them:
Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world. 16Anyone who believes me and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe me will be condemned. 17Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages. 18They will handle snakes and will drink poison and not be hurt. They will also heal sick people by placing their hands on them.
Jesus Returns to Heaven
(Luke 24.50-53; Acts 1.9-11)
19 After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God. 20Then the disciples left and preached everywhere. The Lord was with them, and the miracles they worked proved that their message was true.
ANOTHER OLD ENDING TO MARK'S GOSPEL
21-22 The women quickly told Peter and his friends what had happened. Later, Jesus sent the disciples to the east and to the west with his sacred and everlasting message of how people can be saved forever.
translation_text:
Yezu vo'ore
(Matu 28.1-8; Luki 24.1-12; Yɔn 20.1-10)
1Vo'ohego dabeherɛ n tole la, ti Mɛɛri Magedalin la Yemesi ma Mɛɛri la Salome da' nyuunsuŋɔ kaam ti ba ta bi'ihɛ Yezu iŋa la. 2Yiimbeere bulika ma'aherɛ ma'aherɛ dabeha ayopɔi pɔhega daarɛ, ti suurɛ nan zɔna la, ti ba kiŋɛ yɔɔ la puan. 3Ban ye' la, ti ba sɔkera taaba yeti, “Ani n wan ta bilege kugere la yɔɔ la nuuren bo' tu?” 4Ban pɔri la, ba nyɛ ti yɔɔ kugere la bilege mɛ gã'a kinkɛleŋa ha. Kugere la ba' karegɛ mɛ ka tana ita. 5Ban kɛ̃' yɔɔ la puan la, ba nyɛ la budibele paalega n yɛ fuwoko pɛɛlega, zi'an zuɔ nu'o bɔba, ti dabeem kɛ̃' paaɛ paaɛ. 6Ti budibele paalega wa yele ba yeti, “Da zoti ya dabeem, mam mi' ti ya eere la Yezu n de Nazareti buraa la ti ba daa kpa' pumpuuredɔɔ la zuo la. A vo'e mɛ, a ka boi ka'lam. Bihɛ ya, ban daa dikɛ a iŋa la gã'arɛ zi'an ŋwana. 7 Gee kiŋɛ ya, la ya ta yele a zahereba la Pita ti a diŋɛ nɛŋa yɛ'ɛha Galilii ha. Bilam ti ya wan ta nyɛ en wuu eŋa daa pun yele ya se'em la.” 8Ti ban yehe yɔɔ la puan na la, ti ba ɛkɛ kalam gee bahɛ yɔɔ la se'ere en sɔi la, dabeem la palen-ɛka n kɛ̃' ba. Ti ba kina gee ka sɔhera bɔ'ɔra taaba dabeem la zuo.
MAKI YELEHUM GIREGA BA'AHEGƆ ŊWANA
[En yele ba sɛla za'a la, ba yele de la girega girega bo' sɛba n boi la Pita la. Pooren ti Yezu mɛŋa tum ba ti ba kiŋɛ ze'a woo ta muulɛ ninmu'urɛ la faarɛ yelehum wa n ka sageni wa.]
MAKI YELEHUM WOKO BA'AHEGƆ ŊWANA
Yezu niiɛ amɛŋa pa'alɛ Mɛɛri Magedalin
(Matu 28.9-10; Yɔn 20.11-18)
9[Yezu n vo'e a kum la puan la bulika ma'aherɛ ma'aherɛ, dabeha ayopɔi pɔhega daarɛ la, a niiɛ a mɛŋa pa'alɛ la Mɛɛri yia, Mɛɛri Magedalin se'em ti a sa'ahɛ Kulekpa'bɛ'ɛhi siyopɔi a puan la. 10Ti pɔka wa yehe ta yele sɛba n daa lagum bɔna la Yezu. Bala ma'a la ti bamam nan kele mɛ gee fabela. 11Gee ban ta wum ti Yezu vo'e ya ti pɔka la nyɛ en la, ba kelum ka sakɛ.
Yezu niiɛ amɛŋa pa'alɛ a zahereba bayi'
(Luki 24.13-35)
12Ŋwana pooren ti a le niiɛ a mɛŋa sadɔɔ kuyima le pa'alɛ a zahereba bayi' ti ba boi la sore zuo yɛ'ɛha timpaberɛ la kinkɛleŋa ha. 13Ti ba lebe ta yele ba taaba la, gee ba ka sakɛ bo' ba.
Yezu niiɛ a mɛŋa pa'alɛ a zahereba pia la ayima gee tum ba
(Matu 28.16-20; Luki 24.36-49; Yɔn 20.19-23; Tuuma 1.6-8)
14Pooren ti a zahereba pia la ayima la ta naaɛ taaba ti ba di. Ti Yezu niiɛ amɛŋa pa'alɛ ba gee nyaa nyɔna ba la ban n ka tari sakerɛ la ba tubegirega la doohe la ban ka sakɛ bo' sɛba n nyɛ ti eŋa vo'e ya gee yele ba la. 15 Ti a yele ba yeti, “Kiŋɛ ya timpaberɛ wa zi'an woo ta muulɛ yelesuma wa bo' nɛra woo. 16Se'em woo n sakɛ bo' yelehum la gee sɔ ko'om n wan nyɛ faarɛ, gee se'em woo me n ka sakɛ wan nyɛ sageŋɔ. 17Daalehum buna wan dɔla sɛba n sakɛ la, ba wan dikɛ mam yu'urɛ sa'ahɛ Kulekpa'bɛ'ɛhi, ba wan tɔgɛ zɛlempaala. 18Ba wan nyɔkɛ bunsɛlenduma la ba nu'uhi, gee ba han pun nyu la yabega se'ere kan iŋɛ ba, ba wan dikɛ ba nu'uhi pagelɛ bã'duma zuto ti ba nyɛ ba tibega.”
Yezu zom saazuo
(Luki 24.50-53; Tuuma 1.9-11)
19 Bala Daana Yezu n tɔgɛ bo' ba ba'ahɛ la, a zom la saazuo, ta zi'ire Yinɛ zuɔ nu'o. 20Ti a zahereba la me yiregɛ zi'an woo ta muulɛ yelesuma la bo' nɛra woo, ti Daana la me tum nyalema la kirehi, ti la dɛna daalehum bo' yelehum la.]

english_text:
1Many people have tried to tell the story of what God has done among us. 2They wrote what we had been told by the ones who were there in the beginning and saw what happened. 3So I made a careful study of everything and then decided to write and tell you exactly what took place. Honorable Theophilus, 4I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard.
An Angel Tells about the Birth of John
5 When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron. 6Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded. 7But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
8One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest. 9According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense, 10while the people stood outside praying.
11All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar. 12Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel. 13But the angel told him:
Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John. 14His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad. 15 Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
16John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God. 17 He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
18Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
19 The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news. 20You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
21The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long. 22When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
23When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home. 24Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself, 25“What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.”
An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
26One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee 27 with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David. 28The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
29Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant. 30Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you, 31 and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus. 32 He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was. 33He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
34Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
35The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God. 36Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son. 37 Nothing is impossible for God!”
38Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her.
Mary Visits Elizabeth
39A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea. 40She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth. 41When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her.
The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth. 42 Then in a loud voice she said to Mary:
God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have. 43Why should the mother of my Lord come to me? 44As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me. 45The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise.
Mary's Song of Praise
46 Mary said:
With all my heart
I praise the Lord,
47and I am glad
because of God my Savior.
48God cares for me,
his humble servant.
From now on,
all people will say
God has blessed me.
49God All-Powerful has done
great things for me,
and his name is holy.
50He always shows mercy
to everyone
who worships him.
51The Lord has used
his powerful arm
to scatter those
who are proud.
52 God drags strong rulers
from their thrones
and puts humble people
in places of power.
53God gives the hungry
good things to eat,
and sends the rich away
with nothing.
54God helps his servant Israel
and is always merciful
to his people.
55 The Lord made this promise
to our ancestors,
to Abraham and his family
forever!
56Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home.
The Birth of John the Baptist
57When Elizabeth's son was born, 58her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
59 Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father. 60But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
61The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.” 62So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
63Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed. 64At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.
65All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things. 66Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him.
Zechariah Praises the Lord
67The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
68Praise the Lord,
the God of Israel!
He has come
to save his people.
69Our God has given us
a mighty Savior
from the family
of David his servant.
70Long ago the Lord promised
by the words
of his holy prophets
71to save us from our enemies
and from everyone
who hates us.
72God said he would be kind
to our people and keep
his sacred promise.
73He told our ancestor Abraham
74that he would rescue us
from our enemies.
Then we could serve him
without fear,
75by being holy and good
as long as we live.
76 You, my son, will be called
the prophet of God Most High.
You will go ahead of the Lord
to get everything ready
for him.
77You will tell his people
that they can be saved
when their sins
are forgiven.
78God's love and kindness
will shine upon us
like the sun that rises
in the sky.
79 On us who live
in the dark shadow
of death
this light will shine
to guide us
into a life of peace.
80As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_text:
Gɔŋɔ wa gulehɛ bo' la Tiyofilose
1Lan de ti nɛreba zo'e zo'e maahum ti ba gulehɛ ti la doohe taaba, yele sɛ'a en wa'am asira na tumam tiŋasuka la, 2wuu ban dikɛ a se'em bo' tumam la, bamam sɛba en daa boi pi'ileŋo puan na, dɛna aze'nyɛ duma gee dɛna yamehi bo' yelehum la. 3Mam me iŋɛ n puti'irɛ, doohe mam ma'ɛ n mɛŋa viihɛ sɛla woo en pɔhɛ se'em la yia na la, ti n gulehɛ doohe taaba taaba bo' fum, zuodaana Tiyofilose, 4ti la bahɛ ti fum mina yelemɛŋerɛ se'ere en boi yele sɛ'a woo ti ba pa'alɛ fum la puan.
Yɔn Ko'sɔɔra la dɔgum Yɛla
5 Dabeha sɛ'a puan ti Hɛrɔd dɛna Yuda naba la, ti malema daana ayima en boi, ti a yu'urɛ yi'ira Zekariya, yehe malema daana Abiya yizuo la puan na, ti a pɔga dɛna Aron yaaŋa, ti ka yu'urɛ yi'ira Elizabɛte. 6Ba bayi' la dela tuuntɔɔ duma Yinɛ nɛŋan, ti ba vom tigɛ Yinɛ nini, dɔla Daana la nɔze'elego la a kiha woo puan. 7Gee ba ka tari bia, se'ere en sɔi la, Elizabɛte dela kundɔgerɛ, ti ba za'a me kuregɛ.
8Saŋa kayima ti Zekariya wa tuna a malema daana tuuma Yinɛ nɛŋan la, bamam wele la kaabegɔ saŋa en paaɛ, 9ti ba ŋmɛ' gbaŋa looe en, wuu malema duma la itegɔ en de se'em la, ti a kɛ̃ tuulum saraa la puan ta nyɔ' nyuuŋo suŋɔ zu'uhi bo' Yinɛ. 10Se'em ma'a ti a ta nyɔ'ɔra nyuuŋo suŋa zu'uhi kaabegɔ la, ti lageŋɔ la nɛreba la za'a ze' la yiŋa pu'uhera. 11Ti Daana la suŋera niiɛ a mɛŋa a nɛŋan, zɛ'a zu'uhi nyɔ'a bimbine la zuɔ bɔba. 12Zekariya en nyɛ en la, a paleŋa ɛkɛ mɛ, ti dabeem kɛ̃' en paaɛ paaɛ. 13Gee suŋera la yele en yeti, “Da zɔta dabeem Zekariya, Yinɛ wum fum pu'uhegɔ la. Fum pɔga Elizabɛte wan dɔgɛ bibudibila bo' fum, ti fum sigɛ ka yu'urɛ Yɔn. 14Fum wan tara pupeelum la nyɛɛma, ti nɛreba zo'e zo'e me wan nyɛɛna bia wa dɔgum zuo, 15 se'ere en sɔi la, ka yeti ka dɛna la nɛre kãtɛ, Daana la zi'an. Ka da makɛ nyu daam bii sɛla en kpe'em. Ba ta dɔgera ka la, ti ka pun pirɛ mɛ la Fa'a Sia la. 16Ka wan ŋmɛregɛ Izirale nɛreba zo'e zo'e suya lebe Daana la en de ba Yinɛ la ze'a na. 17 A wan bɔna a nɛŋa la Sɛsɛka, la pansɛka en yuum boi Elia puan la, ti a ŋmɛregɛ dɔgereba suya lebe ba kɔma puan na, gee ŋmɛregɛ sɛba en ka nane suya lebe tuntɔɔnɛ duma yɛm puan na, gee maahum nɛreba bo' Daana la.” 18Zekariya yele suŋera la yeti, “N wan iŋɛ la ŋwani baŋɛ ti la ti dɛna wa dela bala, mam kuregɛ, ti n pɔga me yuuma ka pɔ'ɛ wa?” 19 Ti suŋera la lerege en yeti, “Mam dela Gaberɛl.” Mam ze' la Yinɛ nɛŋan, gee ti a tum mam na, ti n tari yelesunɛ wa na bo' fum. 20Gee nananawa, fum en ka nam mam yelehum la en yeti bu wa'am na tum bu saŋa puan la zuo, fum wan maam kan tana tɔgera, gura daanse'ere ti yele ana wa wan tum.
21Ŋwana woo la, ti nɛreba la guri Zekariya mɛ, ti'iha sɛla en bahɛ ti a yuura bala tuulum deo la puan ha. 22En ta yehe na la, a ka tã tɔgera wan tɔgɛ bo' ba. Ti nɛreba la mɛŋa baŋɛ ti a nyɛ la lilegere tuulum deo la puan, ti a tara a nu'uhi yibeha pa'ala ba, gee kan ta'am tɔgɛ. 23A malema tuuma dabeha la en ta ba'ahɛ la, a lebe kule la a yire.
24Dabeha aŋa pooren ti a pɔga Elizabɛte yee sia, sugera a mɛŋa ŋmarehi sinuu. A yeti, 25“Daana en iŋɛ sɛla bo' mam en ŋwana. Dabeha ana puan, a bihɛ mam mɛ la zu'uhegɔ gee yehe nyanɛ se'ere ti n nyɛta n nɛreba wa puan bahɛ.”
Yezu Dɔgum
26Yuunɛ puan, ŋmarehi siyoobe puan, ti Yinɛ tum a Suŋera Gaberɛl Galilii en boi Nazareti tiŋa puan, 27 pɔgesa'kaherɛ ti ba maahum ti de ele buraa yu'urɛ en yi'ira Yosefe, en de naba Deviti yire puan. Pɔgesa'kaherɛ wa yu'urɛ yi'iri la Mɛɛri. 28Ti Suŋera la wa'am a zi'an na, pu'uhɛ en yeti, “Fum fara fara, zusuŋɔ daana wa, Daana la boi mɛ la hɔ.” 29Gee Mɛɛri maam mɛ la a yetɔgum la, ti'ihɛ pu'uhegɔ wa vuurɛ en de sɛla. 30Ti Suŋera la yele en yeti, “Da zɔta dabeem Mɛɛri, Yinɛ en zu'uhɛ hɔ. 31 Fum yeti fum nyɔkɛ la puurɛ dɔgɛ budibela, sigɛ ka yu'urɛ Yezu. 32 Ka yeti ka ta dɛna la nɛre kãtɛ, ti ba yi'ira en Gani za'a Yinɛ wa Dayua. Daana la en de Yinɛ la, wan dikɛ ka sɔyaaba Deviti na'amkuka la bo' en. 33Eŋa en wan sɔna Yakɔbe sɔ'ɔlum la za'a bihera wuuha. Han dɛna ka sɔ'ɔlum la, bu ka tara tɛka.” 34Ti Mɛɛri soke suŋera la yeti, “Ŋwana yeti la iŋɛ la ŋwani iŋɛ, gee ti mam dɛna pɔgesa'kaherɛ wa?” 35Ti Suŋera la yele en yeti, “Fa'a Sia la wan sige fum zuo, ti Gani Za'a Daana paŋa pi' fum. Bala zuo, bia la ti fum yeti fum dɔgɛ la wan dɛna la Fa'a. Ba wan yi'ira ka la Yinɛ Dayua. 36Nananawa, fum suuɔ Elizabɛte la a kuregerɛ la za'a, tari la puurɛ, ti bia la dɛna budibela, a ŋmarehi siyoobe en ŋwana. Se'em ti ba daa yi'ira kundɔgerɛ la n bala. 37 Sɛla ka boi kpe'em bo' Yinɛ.” 38Ti Mɛɛri yeti, “Mam en ŋwana, mam dela Daana la yameŋa. Bahɛ ti la iŋɛ bo' mam doohe fum yelehum la.” Ti Suŋera la kiŋɛ.
Mɛɛri kiŋɛ bihɛ Elizabɛte
39Dabeha aŋa mɛa puan, ti Mɛɛri yehe kabelɛ kiŋɛ Yudiya tiŋa en boi zoore zuo la, 40ta kɛ̃ Zekariya yire, pu'uhɛ Elizabɛte. 41Ti Elizabɛte en wum Mɛɛri pu'uhegɔ la, bia la damɛ mɛ a puuren ha. Ti Elizabɛte pirɛ la Fa'a Sia la, 42kaahɛ supi yeti, “Sum boi fum zuo gana pɔgehi za'a, sum boi mɛ la walɛ se'ere en boi fum puuren wa. 43Gee beni ti la iŋɛ mam ŋwana, ti mam Daana ma wa'am mam zi'an na? 44Mam en kɔ'ɔm wum fum pu'uhegɔ la, bihɛ, bia la en boi mam puuren la dam mɛ la nyɛɛma. 45Sum bɔna la fum se'em en nam ti Daana la en yele se'em la wan sirum wa'am na tum la.”
Mɛɛri Yuunɛ
46 Ti Mɛɛri yeti,
“Mam suure wa pɛgɛ mam Daana la mɛ,
47ti mam sia me nyɛɛna Yinɛ en de mam Faara wa puan,
48 se'ere en sɔi la, a bihɛ mam mɛ la zu'uhɛ, a yameŋa wa en dagi sɛla wa.
Asira, pɔhɛ zina yɛ'a paara buuri saŋa woo, nɛra woo wan yi'ira mam la Sum.
49Se'ere en sɔi la, Gaŋɛ Za'a Daana la tum la yele kãra bo' mam.
A yu'urɛ dela la Fa'a.
50A nimbɔ'zɔrɛ boi bɔ'ɔra la sɛba en zoti en
buuri saŋa woo puan.
51A pa'alɛ la a paŋa la a nu'o.
A yiregɛ pa'ali mɛŋa duma suya ti'ihegɔ la za'a bahɛ mɛ.
52 Eŋa en sigeheri paheduma, ba na'am zuo,
gee zɛkera tarenduma.
53Eŋa en piti sɛba ti kom tara ba, la lɔgesunɔ,
gee bahera ti buntateba kina nu'bɛɛla.
54A suŋɛ a yameŋa Izirale mɛ,
ti a tɛra a nimbɔ'zɔrɛ la,
55 doohe la a nɔbiŋere ti a biŋe la tu sɔyaabeduma,
Aberaham la a yaahi ti de ka tara ba'ahegɔ la.”
56Ti Mɛɛri yee kɛ̃ la en wuu ŋmarehi sitã, gee lebe kule.
Yɔn ko'sɔɔra la dɔgum
57Ti saŋa la ta paaɛ ti Elizabɛte dɔgɛ, ti a dɔgɛ budibela. 58Ti a mabiihi, la a mɛŋa nɛreba za'a wum ti Daana la zɔ a nimbu'ɔ, ti ba za'a lagum nyɛɛna la en.
59 Dabeha anii daarɛ en de ba ŋma bia la buraanɛ la, ti ba maahena ti ba dikɛ bia la sigɛ ka sɔ Zekariya. 60Ti ka ma yeti, “Aayi, bia la yu'urɛ dela Yɔn.” 61Ti nɛreba la yele en yeti, “Nɛra ka boi fum buuri wa puan tara yu'dina.” 62Gee nyaa pɔhɛ yibeha nu'uhi pa'ala bia la sɔ la ti ba baŋɛ yu'urɛ se'ere ti a bɔta ti ba dikɛ sigɛ bia la. 63Ti a yibehɛ pa'alɛ ba ti ba bo' en sɛla ti a gulehɛ iŋɛ bini, ti ba bo' en, ti a gulehɛ yeti, “Bia la yu'urɛ yi'iri la Yɔn.” Ti la iŋɛ nɛreba la za'a pakerɛ paaɛ paaɛ. 64En ba'ahɛ bala la, bilam bilam ti a ya'ɛ nuurɛ ti a zɛleŋa lorege, ti a tana tɔgera, nyaa pɛgera Yinɛ. 65Ti dabeem kɛ̃ sɛba woo en lɛm ba la, ti ba tɔgera yele ana woo zoore zuo tiŋa la en boi Yuda puan la za'a. 66Ti sɛba woo en wum yele ana wa la, ti'iha yeti, “Beni nɛra ti bikana wa nyaa yeti ka zo'e na dɛna?” Se'ere en sɔi la, la dela sira ti Daana la nu'o en page ka zuo.
Zekariya purega
67Ti bia wa sɔ Zekariya, pirɛ la Fa'a Sia la, nyaa purɛ purega wa yeti,
68“Sum dɛna Izirale Daana en de Yinɛ la dinɛ,
Se'ere en sɔi la, a zɔ a nɛreba la nimbu'ɔ mɛ, gee yɔ to'e ba.
69Yinɛ bo' tu la faara en sɔi a mɛŋa,
yehe a yameŋa Deviti yire puan na, 70wuu en tɔgɛ se'em doohe diimen diimen tuulum nɔtɔgeheba la nɔya puan se'em
71yeti, tu wan to'e tu mɛhi tu dinduma, la sɛba woo en yaaɛ tu la nu'uhen.
72A pa'alɛ tɔ a nimbɔ'zɔrɛ se'ere ti a yuum tara bo' tu yaabeduma la, a tiɛ a tuulum nɔbiŋere la mɛ,
73en yuum biŋe a nuurɛ se'ere la pɔtɛ bo' tu yaaba Aberaham
ti a wan bahɛ ti tumam sɛba 74ti a faaɛ tɔ tu dinduma nu'uhen bahɛ la,
wan tuna bɔ'ɔra en; ti dabeem ka tara tɔ, 75ti tu dɛna tuulum nɛreba, tara tuuntɔɔ vom bɔna a nɛŋan
tu vom dabeha woo puan la.
76 Gee fum bia wa, fum yu'urɛ wan yi'ira la Gaŋɛ Za'a Daana la Nɔtɔgeha.
Se'ere en sɔi la, fum en wan diŋɛ Daana la nɛŋa maalɛ a sɔya la biŋe en,
77Fum bo' a nɛreba la faarɛ mi'ilum,
doohe ba be'em la sugeri dia,
78tumam Yinɛ la nimbɔ'zɔrɛ la zuo.
Niihum wan ze'ele saazuo ha niiɛ bo' tumam na.
79 Bo wan niiɛ bo' sɛba en zi' lika puan, la sɛba en boi Kum nyɔ̃pɔ̃hega puan.
Bo wan niiɛ gu'ura tu nama suma'ahum sore la zuo.”
80Ti bia wa malum zɔ'ɔra Fa'a Sia la paŋa puan, bɔna muuen ha a ma'a, ta paaɛ daanse'ere ti a niiɛ a mɛŋa pa'alɛ Iziraleduma la.

english_text:
The Birth of Jesus
(Matthew 1.18-25)
1About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books. 2These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
3Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed. 4So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
5Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby, 6and while they were there, 7she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn.
The Shepherds
8That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep. 9 All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened. 10But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy. 11This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord. 12You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
13Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
14“Praise God in heaven!
Peace on earth to everyone
who pleases God.”
15After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.” 16They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
17When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him. 18Everyone listened and was surprised. 19But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
20As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
21 Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby.
Simeon Praises the Lord
22 The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born.
They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord, 23 just as the Law of the Lord says, “Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.” 24The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
25At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him 26and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
27When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple. 28Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
29“Lord, I am your servant,
and now I can die in peace,
because you have kept
your promise to me.
30With my own eyes I have seen
what you have done
to save your people,
31and foreign nations
will also see this.
32 Your mighty power is a light
for all nations,
and it will bring honor
to your people Israel.”
33Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said. 34Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him, 35and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.”
Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
36 The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died. 37And now she was 84 years old. Night and day she served God in the temple by praying and often going without eating.
38At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free.
The Return to Nazareth
39 After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee. 40The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him.
The Boy Jesus in the Temple
41 Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover. 42And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration. 43After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city. 44They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him. 45When they could not find him with their relatives and friends, they went back to Jerusalem and started looking for him there.
46Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions. 47Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
48When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
49Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?” 50But they did not understand what he meant.
51Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
52 Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_text:
Yezu dɔgum
(Matu 1.18-25)
1Dabeha aŋa puan la, ti Kaiza Agastus bo' nuurɛ ti ba gulehɛ Arome sɔ'ɔlum nɛreba za'a yu'ura. 2Gulehegɔ kuna en de yia, ti ba iŋɛ, se'em ma'a ti Kurinos dɛna Siriya timbihega nɛŋadaana la. 3Nɛra woo kule la a tiŋa a tiŋa ti ba ta gulehɛ ba yu'ura. 4Ti Yosefe me ze'ele Nazareti en boi Galilii sɔ'ɔlum puan la, yɛ'a Yuda, kula Deviti tinsɛka en yi'iri Bɛtelehɛm la puan, se'ere en sɔi la, Yosefe ze'ele la Deviti buuri puan na. 5A ye' kula ti a ta gulehɛ la a yu'urɛ, eŋa la Mɛɛri se'em ti ba maahena ti a di en, gee ti a me pun gee dɔgum la. 6Ban paaɛ bini la, ti Mɛɛri saŋa paaɛ ti a dɔgɛ a bia la. 7Ti Mɛɛri dɔgɛ a saresare bia en de budibela, pɔbɛ bia la la futo, dikɛ ka gã'arɛ duhi dia dɔɔ puan, se'ere en sɔi la, zi'an ka boi bo' ba ga'aregɔ yire la puan.
Dunkiima la Suŋereba
8Tinkana wa puan, dunkiima basɛba en boi muuen ha la gu'ura ba piihi yu'ukuŋɔ mɛa puan. 9Ti Daana la suŋera en bala zɛ'a ba nɛŋan, ti Daana suŋa niiɛ bilam piim kaaɛ ba bahɛ tiŋasuka, ti ba pabegɛ. 10Ti suŋera la yele ba yeti, “Da zoti ya dabeem, bihɛ ya, mam tari la yelesunɛ en tari nyɛɛma kãtɛ yɛ'a ya zi'an na, ti n bo' nɛreba woo. 11Zina dabeherɛ wa, Deviti sɔ'ɔlum wa puan, ba dɔgɛ faara la en de Kiresta la, dɛna Daana la. 12Dina en wan dɛna daalehum bo' ya. Ya wan ta nyɛ bia la, ti ba pɔbɛ ka mɛ la futo, dikɛ ka gã'arɛ duhi dia dɔɔ zuo.” 13Bilam bilam ti suŋereba kekeko en bala en ze'ele saazuo na lagum suŋera ayima la, ti ba pɛgera Yinɛ yeti,
14“Pɛka paaɛ Yinɛ, se'em en boi saazuin zuin ha wa,
gee ti timpaberɛ wa me zuo, suma'ahum bɔna la saaleba ti a zu'uhɛ ba la!”
15Suŋereba la en bahɛ dunkiima wa gee lebe zom saazuo la, ti dunkiima wa yele taaba yeti, “Bahɛ ya ti tu kiŋɛ Bɛtelehɛm nananawa, la tu ta bihɛ yele dina wa en iŋɛ, ti Daana la lilege pa'alɛ tu wa.” 16Ti dunkiima la ihege kabela yɛ'a, ta paaɛ nyɛ Mɛɛri la Yosefe, gee nyɛ bia la me ti ka gã'a duhi dia dɔɔ la puan. 17Ban nyɛ ŋwana la, ti ba nyaa yele bamam en wum se'ere doohe bia wa puan, 18ti sɛba woo en wum dunkiima wa la, la iŋɛ ba la pakerɛ. 19Gee Mɛɛri to'e ban yele sɛla woo la mɛ la nimu'urɛ, gee nyaa ti'iha a suuren. 20Ti dunkiima wa lɛbera, gee na'aha gee pɛgera Yinɛ, la sɛla ti ba wum gee nyɛ, wuu suŋereba la en yele ba se'em la.
Yezu yu'urɛ sika
21 Dabeha anii en tole la, bia la buraanɛ ŋmaaɛ saŋa en bala, ti ba sigɛ ka yu'urɛ Yezu, yu'se'ere ti suŋera la yuum bo' en gee ti ba baŋɛ nyɔkɛ ka puurɛ la.
22 Peere malema saŋa la en ta paaɛ la, wuu Moose pa'alegɔ la en de se'em la, ti ba tari Yezu kiŋɛ Yerusalɛm, ti ba ta dikɛ en bo' Daana la, 23 (wuu lan gulehɛ se'em bɔna Daana la pa'alegɔ la puan yeti, “Bidiiŋa woo en de bundɔɔ dela tuulum lɔkɔ bo' Daana la”), 24ti ba nyaa kaabɛ kaabegɔ doohe lan gulehɛ se'em bɔna Daana pa'alegɔ la puan la‘, “Naduma dayɛma ayi', bii barebale'ero bibehi tuyi'.”
25Bala ma'a ti buraa kayima en boi Yerusalɛm ti ka yu'urɛ yi'ira Simeyɔn, dɛna tuuntɔɔ, kaabɛ a mɛŋa bo' Yinɛ, gee gura Izirale sumbugelegɔ dabeherɛ la. Ti Fa'a Sia pirɛ en. 26Fa'a Sia la tabelɛ lilege pa'alɛ en mɛ yeti, “A kan ki, gura ti a nini ta nyɛ Daana la en de Kiresta la. 27Ti Fa'a Sia la tari Simeyɔn wa wa'am pu'uhegɔ yire la puan na, ti Yezu dɔgereba tari Yezu kɛ̃ pu'uhegɔ yire la puan na, ti ba malum a malema wuu pa'alegɔ la en pa'alɛ se'em la, 28ti Simeyɔn to'e bia la a nu'uhen pɛgera Yinɛ yeti,
29“N Daana, nyaa bahɛ mam fum yameŋa wa ti n vo'ohe bala la suma'ahum,
wuu fum en yele se'em la.
30Se'ere en sɔi la, mam nini nyaa nyɛ fum faarɛ la,
31ti fum maahum dɛ nɛreba woo nɛŋan la.
32 Se'em en de niihum wan niiɛ ti sɛba n dagi Yuuduma nyɛta la.
Se'em en wan tari pɛka wa'am fum nɛreba Iziraleduma zuo na la.”
33Ti bia la sɔ la ka ma yari zɛ'a yɛli, la ban tɔgeri bia la yele se'em la. 34Ti Simeyɔn ka' sum bo' bia la dɔgereba la, gee yele bia la ma Mɛɛri yeti, bihɛ, “Bikana wa zuo ti nɛreba zo'e zo'e wan lu ti nɛreba zo'e zo'e wan ihege, ka wan dɛna daalehum ti nɛreba zo'e zo'e kan sakɛ bo' ka Izirale puan, 35ti la bahɛ ti yele sɛ'a en sugɛ nɛreba zo'e zo'e suya puan ha la niiɛ na, gee ti su'a lu' fum mɛŋa me.”
36Nɔtɔgeha ayima me en da boi ti a yu'urɛ yi'ira Anna, dɛna Fanuyel en de Asere buuri la poyua. A wa ba' kuregɛ mɛ. A pɔgesa'aren na ti a ele ta paaɛ yuuma ayopɔi ti a sira a ka wa bɔna. 37Ti en pun dɛna pokuurɛ en de woo yuuma pihinii la anaahi la, a ka baheri pu'uhegɔ yire la puan, a kɔ'ɔm bɔna la bilam la nɔlurɛ gee suha Yinɛ yu'uŋɔ la wuntɛɛŋa za'a. 38Sankaŋa mɛa puan ti ka me kɛ̃ pu'uhegɔ yire la puan na, pɔhɛ pɛgera Yinɛ, gee tɔgera bia la yele bɔ'ɔra sɛba woo en guri Yerusalɛm faarɛ la.
Yezu la a dɔgereba lebe Nazareti
39 Ban doohe malema la en de se'em Daana ze'elego la puan ba'ahɛ la, ba lebe la ba mɛŋa tiŋa Nazareti en boi Galilii puan. 40Ti bia wa zɔ'ɔra, kpe'em, pirɛ la yɛm, ti Yinɛ zu'uhegɔ bɔna ka zuo.
Yezu yee pu'uhegɔ yire
41 Nananawa,Yuunɛ woo, Yezu dɔgereba ni kiŋɛ la Yerusalɛm ta di azɔɛtole de'eŋo la. 42Ti Yezu en ta dɛna yuumpia la ayi' la, ti eŋa la a dɔgereba la kiŋɛ zom de'eŋo la, wuu ban ni pun kina se'em la. 43De'eŋo la dabeha en ta ba'ahɛ la, ti a dɔgereba la yɛ'a lɛbera ba tiŋa la, Yezu en nan de bumbila la, yee la Yerusalɛm, ti a dɔgereba la ka baŋɛ. 44A dɔgereba la ti'ihɛ ti a lagum bɔna la nɛrekuuŋɔ la puan, gee kiŋɛ daanyinɛ kinɛ. Ti ba pɔhɛ ɛɛra bia la ba mabiihi la ba zɔduma zi'an. 45Ti ban ka nyɛ bia la, ba lebe la Yerusalɛm, ta ɛɛra en. 46Ti la iŋɛ ti Dabeha atã ta tole, ti ba nyɛ en pu'uhegɔ yire la puan, ti a zi'a la pa'aleba la, kɛleha ba, gee sɔgeha ba yɛla. 47Ti la iŋɛ sɛba woo en kelehe en la pakerɛ, la a bɔkerɛ, la a leregere la. 48A dɔgereba la en wa'am na nyɛ en la, la iŋɛ ba la pakerɛ, ti a ma yele en yeti, “Bia wa, ŋwani ti fum iŋɛ tu ŋwana? Bihɛ, fum sɔ la mam eere fum mɛ bala la ninmu'urɛ.” 49Ti a yele ba yeti, “Ŋwani ti ya ɛɛra mam bala? Yamam ka mi' ti n suni ti n bɔna n Sɔ yire la puan?” 50Gee a dɔgereba la ka bɔkɛ en yele ba sɛla la vuurɛ. 51Ti a doohe ba kule Nazareti, ta kɛ̃'ɛ̃ra la a dɔgereba la, gee nana ba. Ti a ma dikɛ yele ana wa woo suŋa suŋa a suuren.
52 Ti Yezu zɔ'ɔra la yɛm, kahegerɛ, Yinɛ zu'uhegɔ la saaleba zu'uhegɔ.

english_text:
The Preaching of John the Baptist
(Matthew 3.1-12; Mark 1.1-8; John 1.19-28)
1For 15 years Emperor Tiberius had ruled that part of the world. Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, and Herod was the ruler of Galilee. Herod's brother, Philip, was the ruler in the countries of Iturea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias was the ruler of Abilene. 2Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests.
At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert. 3So John went along the Jordan Valley, telling the people, “Turn back to God and be baptized! Then your sins will be forgiven.” 4 Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said,
“In the desert
someone is shouting,
‘Get the road ready
for the Lord!
Make a straight path
for him.
5Fill up every valley
and level every mountain
and hill.
Straighten the crooked paths
and smooth out
the rough roads.
6Then everyone will see
the saving power of God.’ ”
7 Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, “You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment? 8 Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham. 9 An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into a fire.”
10The crowds asked John, “What should we do?”
11John told them, “If you have two coats, give one to someone who doesn't have any. If you have food, share it with someone else.”
12 When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
13John told them, “Don't make people pay more than they owe.”
14Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?”
John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
15Everyone became excited and wondered, “Could John be the Messiah?”
16John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire. 17His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in his barn and burn the husks with a fire that never goes out.”
18In many different ways John preached the good news to the people. 19 But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things. 20Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done.
The Baptism of Jesus
(Matthew 3.13-17; Mark 1.9-11)
21While everyone else was being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. Then as he prayed, the sky opened up, 22 and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in the form of a dove. A voice from heaven said, “You are my own dear Son, and I am pleased with you.”
The Ancestors of Jesus
(Matthew 1.1-17)
23When Jesus began to preach, he was about 30 years old. Everyone thought he was the son of Joseph. But his family went back through Heli, 24Matthat, Levi, Melchi, Jannai, Joseph, 25Mattathias, Amos, Nahum, Esli, Naggai, 26Maath, Mattathias, Semein, Josech, Joda;
27Joanan, Rhesa, Zerubbabel, Shealtiel, Neri, 28Melchi, Addi, Cosam, Elmadam, Er, 29Joshua, Eliezer, Jorim, Matthat, Levi;
30Simeon, Judah, Joseph, Jonam, Eliakim, 31Melea, Menna, Mattatha, Nathan, David, 32Jesse, Obed, Boaz, Salmon, Nahshon;
33Amminadab, Admin, Arni, Hezron, Perez, Judah, 34Jacob, Isaac, Abraham, Terah, Nahor, 35Serug, Reu, Peleg, Eber, Shelah;
36Cainan, Arphaxad, Shem, Noah, Lamech, 37Methuselah, Enoch, Jared, Mahalaleel, Kenan, 38Enosh, and Seth.
The family of Jesus went all the way back to Adam and then to God.
translation_text:
Yɔn Ko'sɔɔra la muulegɔ
(Matu 3.1-12; Maki 1.1-8; Yɔn 1.19-28)
1Yuuma pia la anuu, Kaiza Tiberiyusi na'am kuka zuo saŋa la, ti Pɔntiyɔsi Palete dɛna timbihega nɛŋa daana Yudiya, ti Hɛrɔd me sɔna Galilii bihera, ti a suuɔ Filipi me sɔna Iturea la Tirakonitise tihi bihera, ti Lisaniyase me sɔna Abilene tiŋa bihera, 2ti Annas la Kaifase dɛna malema kiinduma la, ti Yinɛ dikɛ a yelehum doohe Zekariya dayua Yɔn puan, muɔ puan ha. 3Ti Yɔn doohe tihi la woo en kaaɛ Yɔɔdan la, muula teere ko'om sua, la be'em sugeri dia, bɔ'ɔra nɛreba la, 4 wuu lan gulehɛ se'em nɔtɔgeha Azaaya gɔŋɔ la puan se'em yeti,
“Nɛra ayima kua en boi muuen kaaha baha na yeti,
Maalɛ Daana la sore la,
Maalɛ ya a sadɔtɔ la tuuntɔɔ.
5Naherɛ woo Palehɛ,
ti zoore la kunkune woo sirege,
ti sadɔɔ ŋmɛleŋɔ woo tiɛ,
ti sadɔtɔ-ɛ̃rema woo saalum,
6gee ti saala woo nyɛ Yinɛ Faarɛ la.”
7 Yɔn yele nɛrekuuŋɔ la en yehe na ti a bo' ba ko'om sua la yeti, “Kampɛbibehi wa, ani en kagɛ ya ti ya zɔ yehe Yinɛ sunsunyiim tuulɛ la en ye' na la puan?
8Bala zuo, wam ya wala sɛ'a en pa'alɛ ti ya tee mɛ. Gee da yɛta ya mɛhi ti, ‘Aberaham en de tumam yaaba.’ N yeti ya mɛ wa, ti Yinɛ ta'am bahɛ ti kuga wa a sɛ'a lebege kɔma bo' Aberaham. 9Nananawa, liya la maahum mɛ gã'a tiihi nyɛga zuto, ti tisɛka woo en ka wani walesuma, ka ŋmaaɛ bahɛ, lobe ka bahɛ bugum puan.”
10Ti nɛrekuuŋɔ la soke en yeti, “Beni ti tu nyaa wan iŋɛ?” 11Ti Yɔn lerege ba yeti, “Se'em woo en tari futo tuyi', tɔrɛ bo' se'em woo en ka tari la. Fum se'em woo en tari dita, me iŋɛ bala mɛa.” 12Ti kubetɔ'ɔhereba me lagum wa'am na ti ba sɔ ko'om la, gee soke en yeti, “Pa'ala, beni ti tumam me wan iŋɛ?” 13Ti a yele ba yeti, “Da to'ohe ya kuba la gaŋɛ lan de se'em.” 14Ti pɛntiireba me soke en yeti, “Gee tumam, beni ti tu wan iŋɛ?” Ti a yele ba yeti, “Da pɛregɛ ya se'em to'e ligeri, bii ya zuuhe se'em gee ka nyɛ, gee me bahɛ ti ya nini tigɛ la ya yɔɔrɛ ma'a.” 15Nɛreba suya en daa pun maahum gura la, ba daa nyaa sokere mɛ ba suya puan nyaa,Yɔn wan dɛna Kiresta la? 16Ti Yɔn lerege ba za'a yeti, “Mam sɔɔri ya mɛ la ko'om wa, gee se'em en kpe'em gana mam kini na, mam ka nari n pun lorege a tagera mi'a. Eŋa wan sɔ ya mɛ la Fa'a Sia, la bugum. 17A zãli la a yeelego wanɛ, ti a yeele sɛla woo en boi a tooren la, la a mui la iŋɛ a bããrɛ puan, gee vagela la, a wan nyɔ' ba bugum sebo en ka kiŋeri puan.”
18Bala,Yɔn dikɛ la kpemehego yɛla zo'e zo'e tɔgɛ faarɛ yelehum la bo' nɛreba la. 19 Gee Hɛrɔd en de naba ti Yɔn tahɛ en doohe en fa' Hɛrɔdiya en de a suuɔ la pɔga di la, la tuunfi'iha sɛ'a woo ti Hɛrɔd tum la, 20ta pa'ahɛ tuunfi'iherɛ se'ere en gani za'a la, dɛna en pagɛ Yɔn paka deen la.
Yezu to'e ko'om sua
(Matu 3.13-17; Maki 1.9-11; Yɔn 1.32)
21Nananawa Nɛreba la za'a en ta to'e ko'om sua ba'ahɛ la, ti Yezu me tɔ'ɔra a ko'om sua gee a pu'uheri la, ti saazuo yu'ɛ. 22 Ti Fa'a Sia la sige a zuo na, la naanɛ en ani wuu dayene la. Ti kua ze'ele saazuo ha tɔgɛ bahɛ na yeti, “Fum en de mam Dayua ti n nɔŋɛ, mam nini tigɛ mɛ la fum.”
Yezu tuuhum
(Matu 1.1-17)
23Yezu ta dɛna wuu yuum pihitã, gee pɔhɛ a muulegɔ tuuma. A sɔ, (wuu ban ti'ihɛ se'em la) dela Yosefe, en de Hɛli dayua, 24se'em sɔ en de Matati, se'em sɔ en de Levi, se'em sɔ en de Meliki, se'em sɔ en de Yanayi, se'em sɔ en de Yosefe, 25se'em sɔ en de Matatiyase, se'em sɔ en de Amɔsi, se'em sɔ en de Nahum, se'em sɔ en de Ɛsili, se'em sɔ en de Nagai, 26se'em sɔ en de Maati, se'em sɔ en de Matatiyase, se'em sɔ en de Sɛmin, se'em sɔ en de Yoseki, se'em sɔ en de Yoda, 27se'em sɔ en de Yowanan, se'em sɔ en de Aresa, se'em sɔ en de Zerubabɛle, se'em sɔ en de Siyotiyɛl, se'em sɔ en de Nɛri, 28se'em sɔ en de Meliki, se'em sɔ en de Adi, se'em sɔ en de Kosam, se'em sɔ n de Elimadam, se'em sɔ en de Eri, 29se'em sɔ en de Yosua, se'em sɔ en de Ɛliyaza, se'em sɔ en de Yorim, se'em sɔ en de Matati, sɔ en de Levi, 30se'em sɔ en de Simeyɔn, se'em sɔ en de Yuda, se'em sɔ en de Yosefe, se'em sɔ en de Yonam, se'em sɔ en de Eliyakim, 31se'em sɔ en de Meleya, se'em sɔ en de Mina, se'em sɔ en de Natan, se'em sɔ en de Deviti, 32se'em sɔ n de Yesi, se'em sɔ en de Ɔbɛd, se'em sɔ en de Boazi, se'em sɔ en de Sala, se'em sɔ en de Nason, 33se'em sɔ en de Aminadabi, se'em sɔ en de Adim, se'em sɔ en de Aram, se'em sɔ en de Hɛzirɔn, se'em sɔ en de Pɛrezi, se'em sɔ n de Yuda, 34se'em sɔ en de Yakɔbe, se'em sɔ n de Aziki, se'em sɔ n de Aberaham, se'em sɔ n de Tɛra, se'em sɔ n de Nahɔ, 35se'em sɔ n de Seruge, se'em sɔ n de Aru, se'em sɔ n de Pelege, se'em sɔ n de Ɛbɛ, se'em sɔ n de Sɛla 36se'em sɔ en de Keenan, se'em sɔ n de Afagezad, se'em sɔ n de Sɛm, se'em sɔ n de Nowa, se'em sɔ n de Lamɛki, 37se'em sɔ n de Mɛtusɛla, se'em sɔ n de Enɔki, se'em sɔ en de Yared se'em sɔ n de Mahalaleel, se'em sɔ n de Keenan, 38se'em sɔ n de Enose, se'em sɔ n de Sɛti, se'em sɔ n de Adam, se'em sɔ en de Yinɛ.

english_text:
Jesus and the Devil
(Matthew 4.1-11; Mark 1.12,13)
1When Jesus returned from the Jordan River, the power of the Holy Spirit was with him, and the Spirit led him into the desert. 2For 40 days Jesus was tested by the devil, and during that time he went without eating. When it was all over, he was hungry.
3The devil said to Jesus, “If you are God's Son, tell this stone to turn into bread.”
4 Jesus answered, “The Scriptures say, ‘No one can live only on food.’ ”
5Then the devil led Jesus up to a high place and quickly showed him all the nations on earth. 6The devil said, “I will give all this power and glory to you. It has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to. 7Just worship me, and you can have it all.”
8 Jesus answered, “The Scriptures say:
‘Worship the Lord your God
and serve only him!’ ”
9Finally, the devil took Jesus to Jerusalem and had him stand on top of the temple. The devil said, “If you are God's Son, jump off. 10-11 The Scriptures say:
‘God will tell his angels
to take care of you.
They will catch you
in their arms,
and you will not even hurt
your feet on the stones.’ ”
12 Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
13After the devil had finished testing Jesus in every way possible, he left him for a while.
Jesus Begins His Work
(Matthew 4.12-17; Mark 1.14,15)
14Jesus returned to Galilee with the power of the Spirit. News about him spread everywhere. 15He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him.
The People of Nazareth Turn against Jesus
(Matthew 13.53-58; Mark 6.1-6)
16Jesus went back to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and as usual he went to the synagogue on the Sabbath. When he stood up to read from the Scriptures, 17he was given the book of Isaiah the prophet. He opened it and read,
18 “The Lord's Spirit
has come to me,
because he has chosen me
to tell the good news
to the poor.
The Lord has sent me
to announce freedom
for prisoners,
to give sight to the blind,
to free everyone
who suffers,
19and to say, ‘This is the year
the Lord has chosen.’ ”
20Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
21Then Jesus said to them, “What you have just heard me read has come true today.”
22All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
23Jesus answered:
You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum. 24 But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
25 Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel, 26 but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon. 27 During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.
28When the people in the synagogue heard Jesus say this, they became so angry 29that they got up and threw him out of town. They dragged him to the edge of the cliff on which the town was built, because they wanted to throw him down from there. 30But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away.
A Man with an Evil Spirit
(Mark 1.21-28)
31Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath. 32 His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power. 33There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out, 34“Hey, Jesus of Nazareth, what do you want with us? Are you here to get rid of us? I know who you are! You are God's Holy One.”
35Jesus ordered the evil spirit to be quiet and come out. The demon threw the man to the ground in front of everyone and left without harming him.
36They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!” 37News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country.
Jesus Heals Many People
(Matthew 8.14-17; Mark 1.29-34)
38Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever. 39So Jesus went over to her and ordered the fever to go away. Right then she was able to get up and serve them a meal.
40After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them. 41Demons went out of many people and shouted, “You are the Son of God!” But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.
42The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving. 43But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.” 44So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.
translation_text:
Yezu Makerɛ
(Matu 4.1-11; Maki 1.12, 13)
1Ti Yezu pirɛ la Fa'a Sia la, ze'ele Yɔɔdan lebe na, ti Sia la tari en kɛ̃ kpaahenɛ puan ha, 2ti a ta bɔna bini dabeha pihinaahi, ti Sagena la makɛ en bihɛ. Dabeha pihinaahi wa puan a ka di sɛla, ti dabeha la en ta ba'ahɛ la, ti kom tara en. 3Ti Sagena la yele en yeti, “Fum han sirum dɛna la Yinɛ bia, bo' nuurɛ, ti kuga wa lebege boroboro.” 4 Ti Yezu lerege en yeti, “La gulehɛ yeti, ‘Nɛra ka vɔi mɛ la dia ma'a.’ ”
5Ti Sagena la tari en zom zi'an, ta ze'ele bilam pa'alɛ en sɔ'ɔlum la woo en boi timpaberɛ wa zuo la za'a bilam bilam. 6Ti Sagena la yele en yeti, “Fum ti en wan dikɛ bana woo, la ba pahi la suŋa la za'a bo'. Se'ere en sɔi la, ba dikɛ ba bo' la mam, ti mam me dikera bɔ'ɔra se'em ti n bɔta. 7Fum han wan na'ahɛ mam, ba za'a dela fum dinɛ.” 8 Ti Yezu lerege en yeti, “La gulehɛ yeti,
‘Na'aha Daana la en de fum Yinɛ la,
gee tuna bɔ'ɔra eŋa ma'a.’ ”
9Ti Sagena la tari Yezu kiŋɛ Yerusalɛm, tari en ta zom pu'uhegɔ yire la zuin zuin ha, yele en yeti, “Fum han sirum dɛna la Yinɛ bia, ze'ele ka'lam lobe fum mɛŋa bahɛ tiŋa ha, 10 se'ere en sɔi la, la gulehɛ yeti,
‘Yinɛ wan bo' a suŋereba nuurɛ, fum zuo,
ti ba te'ele fum,’
11ti
‘Ba wan te'ele fum la ba nu'uhi,
ti fum na'arɛ kan ŋmɛ kugere.’ ”
12 Ti Yezu lerege en yeti, “La tɔgɛ biŋe yeti, ‘Da makɛ Daana la en de fum Yinɛ la bihɛ.’ ” 13Sagena la n ba'ahɛ mageha la woo la, a bahɛ en mɛ, gee gura sansɛka ti a wan le nyɛ fole.
Yezu pɔhɛ tuuma Galilii
(Matu 4.12-17; Maki 1.14, 15)
14Ti Yezu pirɛ la Fa'a Sia paŋa, lebe Galilii, ti a yele to'e tinse'ehi en kaaɛ la za'a. 15Ti Yezu pɔhɛ pa'alegɔ ba zamehegɔ yiya la puan, ti nɛra woo pɛgera en.
Ba zagehɛ Yezu Nazareti
(Matu 13.53-58; Maki 6.1-6)
16Yezu en lebe Nazareti, zi'an ti a zo'e na la, ta kiŋɛ zamehegɔ yire la puan vo'ohego daarɛ, wuu en ni pun ita se'em la. Nyaa ihege ze'ele ti a kãalɛ, 17ti ba yehe Azaaya gɔŋɔ bo' en. Ti a yirege gɔŋɔ la nyɛ ze'sɛka n gulehɛ yeti,
18“Daana Sia la en boi la mam,
Se'ere en sɔi la, a sɔ mam mɛ
ti n tari faarɛ yelehum wa na bo' naheduma.
A tum mam na ti n wa'am na muulɛ fai yɛla bo' sɛba en boi bobere puan,
gee bihɛ ti fɔɔhi nini pigehɛ
gee bahɛ ti sɛba n boi mugehego puan kiŋɛ fai.
19Ti n muulɛ Daana la nimbɔ'zɔrɛ yuunɛ la.”
20Gee nyaa kilum gɔŋɔ la, dikɛ bo' bituneŋa la, gee lebe zi'ire. Ti nɛra woo n boi zamehegɔ yire la puan la nini kɔ'ɔm kpa' bihera en ziki. 21Ti a pɔhɛ yele ba yeti, “Zina, gɔŋɔ wa zɛ'kana wa'am yelemɛŋerɛ na ya tuban.” 22Ti nɛra woo pɛgera en, gee ti la iŋɛ ba pakerɛ la zu'uhegɔ yele sɛ'a n ze'eti a nuuren na la. Ti ba yɛta yeti, “Dagi Yosefe dayua la n bala?” 23Ti Yezu yele ba yeti, “Mam ka bu'uri, ti ya wan dikɛ yetɔgum biŋere se'ere n yeti, ‘Tibera, tibɛ fum mɛŋa yia’ la, yele mam. Ya me wan yele mam yeti, ‘Tum ka'lam me, fum mɛŋa tiŋa wa puan, daalehum ti tu wum ti fum tum si Kapɛnum la.’ ” 24 Ti Yezu yele ba yeti, “Yelemɛŋerɛ ti n yɛta wa, ti nɔtɔgeha ka boi' ti a mɛŋa tiŋa nɛreba to'e en. 25 De yelemɛŋerɛ la dela, pokɔpa kekeko yuum boi Izirale tiŋa puan mɛ Elia saŋa la, ti saazuo yuum yu', yuuma atã la ŋmarehi siyoobe la. Ti kompɛɛlega yuum to'e tiŋa la za'a la. 26Gee Yinɛ yuum ka bahɛ ti Elia kiŋɛ ba se'em zi'an, han dagena pokuurɛ se'ere n boi Zarefati tiŋa n boi Sidɔn tiŋa la. 27 Insageŋɔ duma me yuum zo'e mɛ Izirale tiŋa wa puan nɔtɔgeha Elisa saŋa la, gee ba ayima me yuum ka nyɛ tibegɔ han dagena Siriya tiŋa buraa Neeman ma'a.” 28Ban wum ŋwana la, ba woo n boi zamehegɔ yire la puan la suya nyiie mɛ. 29Ti ba vaaɛ ihege sa'ɛ en, tari en yehe tiŋa la yiŋa ha, tari en ta paaɛ zoore la ti ba tiŋa mɛ yaga de zuo la zuleŋa ha, ti ba za'ɛ en bahɛ tiŋa ha. 30Gee a lilum la ba puan yehe kiŋɛ.
Buraa en tari sɛfi'iha
(Maki 1.21-28)
31Ti Yezu sige Kapɛnum n boi Galilii sɔ'ɔlum puan la, ta pa'ala nɛreba vo'ohego daarɛ la. 32 Ti la iŋɛ nɛreba la pakerɛ, la a pa'alegɔ la, se'ere en sɔi la, a pa'ali mɛ ti paŋa bɔna bini. 33Zamehegɔ yire la puan, buraa n tari sɛfi'iha boi bini, kaahɛ tagi tagi bahɛ na yeti, 34“Bahɛ tu bããlam, beni tu fum tara la tɔ, Nazareti buraa Yezu wa? Fum wa'am na ti fum sagum tu mɛ? Mam mi' fum n de se'em, fum dela Yinɛ Fa'a nɛra.” 35Ti Yezu tahɛ en yeti, “Go'e suram gee yehe a puan na.” Ti sɛfi'iha la fɔbɛ buraa wa tiŋa nɛreba la nɛŋan, gee nyaa yehe na, gee ka pɔgelum buraa la. 36Ti la iŋɛ nɛra woo pakerɛ, ti ba yɛta taaba yeti, “Beni yele ŋwana? Kpe'eŋo la paŋa ti a tara tahɛ sɛfi'iha ti si yɛha!” 37Ti ba pɔhɛ tɔgera a yele tiŋa la zi'an woo puan.
Simɔn dɛɛmpɔka tibegɔ
(Matu 8.14-17; Maki 1.29-39)
38Yezu n bahɛ zamehegɔ yire la, a kɛ̃ la Simɔn yire. Bala ma'a ti Simɔn dɛɛmpɔka n boi yire la puan ti ka iŋa tulegɛ, ti ba tɔgɛ ka yele bo' Yezu. 39Ti Yezu paaɛ ze'ele ka zuin, tahɛ intulegerɛ la, ti bã'a la bahɛ pɔka la. Ti ka ihege bilam bilam bo' ba ko'om.
40Zaanuurɛ n ta ma'ara la, ti sɛba woo n tari ba nɛreba ti ba bɛ̃'ɛra bã'ahi yima yima la, tari ba kina la Yezu zi'an na, ti a tara a nu'uhi pagela ba ayima ayima zuo, tibera ba. 41Ti kulekpa'bɛ'ɛhi me zɛ'ɛta ba zo'e zo'e puan yɛhera na gee tahera yeti, “Fum n de Yinɛ Dayua la.” Gee ti a ni tahɛ ba, ka bahera ti ba tɔgera, se'ere n sɔi la kulekpa'bɛ'ɛhi la mi' ti Yezu n de Kiresta la.
Yezu tɔgɛ zamehegɔ yiya puan
(Maki 1.35-39)
42Ti beere ta yilegɛ, ti a bahɛ bilam gee kiŋɛ zi'an ti nɛreba ka bɔna bini. Ti nɛrekuuŋɔ ɛɛra en, ban paaɛ en la, ba boti ba gu' en mɛ ti a da bahɛ ba. 43Gee Yezu yele ba yeti, “La dela n muulɛ faarɛ yelehum la n de Yinɛ sɔ'ɔlum yɛla la bo' tihi sise'ehi me. Se'ere n sɔi la ba tum mam la bala zuo na.” 44Bala ti a dɔla muula yelehum la Yudiya zamehegɔ yiya la puan.

english_text:
Jesus Chooses His First Disciples
(Matthew 4.18-22; Mark 1.16-20)
1 Jesus was standing on the shore of Lake Gennesaret, teaching the people as they crowded around him to hear God's message. 2Near the shore he saw two boats left there by some fishermen who had gone to wash their nets. 3Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
4When Jesus had finished speaking, he told Simon, “Row the boat out into the deep water and let your nets down to catch some fish.”
